summary: Marqeta Inc. filed an 8-K with financial results, a director resignation, and a new share repurchase program. On August 3, 2026, the Board authorized an additional $150 million buyback of Class A common stock, replacing the completed December 2025 program. No price per share or premium is stated. The repurchase is subject to liquidity, legal compliance, and ownership concentration considerations. Director Najuma Atkinson resigned July 31 effective August 3, 2026, with no disagreement. Track execution pace and any impact on financial metrics—a pure capital return event.
